product_overview: Siltec-Barber é uma aplicação web de agendamentos para barbearias que permite aos clientes descobrir lojas, consultar serviços e horários, e criar reservas autenticadas. Também oferece aos administradores controle da agenda, serviços, horários de funcionamento, bloqueios e perfil da barbearia.
core_goals: Permitir que clientes encontrem barbearias por nome, serviço e categorias de destaque
Exibir detalhes públicos da barbearia, incluindo serviços, preços, horários e contato
Permitir que clientes autenticados criem, acompanhem e removam suas reservas
Permitir que clientes atualizem seu telefone de contato no perfil
Disponibilizar páginas institucionais com informações de contato, privacidade e termos
Oferecer aos administradores uma visão da operação diária e controle da agenda
Permitir que administradores gerenciem serviços, perfil da barbearia e horários de funcionamento

tech_stack.ui_library: Tailwind CSS v4 + Radix UI (shadcn-style components in app/_components/ui)

tech_stack.other: NextAuth v4 (Google provider, Prisma/database sessions), Prisma 7 + SQLite, Zod, react-hook-form, sonner (toasts), date-fns, react-day-picker, lucide-react, bprogress

routes.description: Customer home. In multi-tenant mode renders the barbershop catalog (CatalogHome) with search, quick service filters and recommended/popular lists.
Searchable/filterable listing of all barbershops with result count, stats cards and empty state.
Barbershop detail page with about section, service list (each with a Reservar button), opening hours and contact phones.
Customer bookings dashboard with confirmed/follow-up bookings, history, totals and empty state. Shows a "need login" message when logged out.
Customer profile showing name/email from Google and a form to save the contact phone.
Static Contact page with WhatsApp deep link and mailto link.
Admin dashboard with statistics. Gated by requireBarbershopAdmin (BARBER_ADMIN role plus barbershopId).
Admin daily agenda with day navigator, calendar, booking rows and schedule block manager.
Admin service catalog CRUD with create/edit/delete dialogs.
Admin shop settings: barbershop profile form and opening hours form.
NextAuth catch-all route handling Google OAuth sign-in/sign-out and session retrieval.

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth credentials are not configured in .env.local (no GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET), so completing a real sign-in is impossible in this environment; authenticated flows can only be exercised up to the sign-in dialog.
known_limitations.impact: Tests that require an authenticated session (create booking, /bookings content, /perfil, and the whole /dashboard /schedule /services /settings admin area) cannot reach their logged-in states.

known_limitations.issue: The seed creates 10 shops and 6 services each but never creates an admin user, and no application flow assigns the BARBER_ADMIN role or a barbershopId.
known_limitations.impact: The admin area has no reachable account in a fresh database.

known_limitations.issue: Several buttons on the listing page have no click handler and do nothing.
known_limitations.impact: The "Filtros", "Ordenar", grid/list view toggles, "Carregar Mais", "Sugerir Barbearia" and "Falar Conosco" buttons are visual only.

known_limitations.issue: Rating, review count and client numbers are hard-coded placeholders rather than real data.
known_limitations.impact: The 4.9 rating, 70 avaliações, 5+ anos, 4.8 average and 98% satisfaction figures never change with data.

known_limitations.issue: Booking stores no price or duration snapshot, and the WhatsApp confirmation is a client-generated wa.me link rather than a server-side message.
known_limitations.impact: Editing a service retroactively changes historical totals, and no message is actually sent without a user click.

known_limitations.issue: Deleting a booking hard-deletes the record instead of setting the status to CANCELED.
known_limitations.impact: Canceled booking history is not preserved.

known_limitations.issue: DEMO_MODE and SINGLE_BARBERSHOP_ID are unset, so the app runs in multi-tenant mode and the single-tenant home branch is not active.
known_limitations.impact: The single-tenant rendering path of the home page and the /barbershops redirect are not exercised.

known_limitations.issue: Booking creation, conflict detection and the three-future-booking cap are non-atomic check-then-insert operations with no database exclusion constraint.
known_limitations.impact: Concurrent bookings can produce double-booked slots; these are not observable in sequential UI tests.
